notes: Tri-Rate 8.5/14.025/28.05 Gb/s Fibre Channel. Unstressed receiver OMA sensitivity at 8.5, 14.025, and 28.05 Gb/s; stress receiver sensitivity -9.5 dBm. For 32GFC with FEC, receiver sensitivity is defined at 10^-6 BER, not 10^-12. Transmitter dispersion penalty @ TDP: 3.2 dB (8.5 Gb/s), 4.4 dB (14.025 Gb/s), 2.7 dB (28.05 Gb/s). Allocation of penalties 2.7 dB; maximum TDP 15.9 dB. Optical return loss 12 dB at 8.5 Gb/s and 14.025 Gb/s, 26 dB at 28.05 Gb/s. Electrical note: total power dissipation shall not exceed 1.3 W with established link; features list 1.5 W maximum with established link. Supply voltage 3.15–3.46 V. Copyright footer identifies Coherent Corp.
